# Stacklyn

> Stacklyn is a software development company in Kerala, India, providing custom software development, AI solutions, SaaS development, and startup MVP development for global clients.

## About Stacklyn

Stacklyn is a full-service software engineering and AI solutions studio founded in Kerala, India. The company builds scalable web applications, AI-powered products, and cloud-native systems for startups, SMEs, SaaS companies, and enterprises worldwide. Stacklyn operates with the speed and focus of a startup team while delivering enterprise-grade engineering quality.

**Founded:** Kerala, India
**Services:** Full Stack Development, MERN Stack, Node.js, React, Next.js, AI Development, SaaS, MVP Development, Custom Software
**Contact:** rahulrp@stacklyn.in | +91 95444 51720
**Website:** https://stacklyn.in
**Founder & CEO:** Rahul R P
**Founder Contact:** rahulrp@stacklyn.in | +91 95444 51720
**Founder LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/in/rahulrp07/

## Founder

**Rahul R P — Founder & CEO, Stacklyn**

Rahul R P is the founder and CEO of Stacklyn, a custom software development and AI engineering studio based in Kerala, India. A hands-on full stack engineer working across React, Next.js, Node.js, cloud infrastructure, and AI/LLM application development, Rahul personally leads product scoping, architecture, and delivery on every Stacklyn engagement — partnering directly with founders and product teams from the first discovery call through production launch. Clients work with a senior engineer, not an account manager.

**Role:** Founder & CEO
**Focus areas:** Full stack engineering, AI application development, cloud architecture, MVP and SaaS delivery
**Education:** Cochin University of Science and Technology
**Email:** rahulrp@stacklyn.in

## Core Services

### Full Stack Development
Stacklyn builds end-to-end web platforms using React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB. Services include web applications, admin dashboards, REST APIs, GraphQL APIs, and database design.
URL: https://stacklyn.in/services/full-stack-development

### MERN Stack Development
Stacklyn specializes in MongoDB, Express.js, React, and Node.js (MERN) development. The team delivers SaaS products, B2B dashboards, and real-time web applications using this modern JavaScript stack.
URL: https://stacklyn.in/services/mern-development

### Backend Development
Stacklyn provides robust backend development using Node.js, Express.js, Fastify, NestJS, and PostgreSQL. Services include API design, microservices, authentication systems, and cloud-native backends.
URL: https://stacklyn.in/services/backend-development

### Node.js Development
Stacklyn builds high-performance Node.js backends for web applications, APIs, and real-time systems. Expertise includes Express.js, Fastify, NestJS, WebSockets, and serverless Node.js deployments.
URL: https://stacklyn.in/services/nodejs-development

### React Development
Stacklyn builds responsive, performant React applications for web and enterprise platforms. Services include React SPA development, component libraries, React + TypeScript codebases, and React performance optimization.
URL: https://stacklyn.in/services/react-development

### Next.js Development
Stacklyn creates production-grade Next.js applications with SSR, SSG, ISR, and App Router. Services include Next.js SaaS products, e-commerce platforms, and SEO-optimized web apps.
URL: https://stacklyn.in/services/nextjs-development

### AI Application Development
Stacklyn develops AI-powered applications using large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and intelligent automation. Services include AI chatbots, AI agents, document processing, and generative AI solutions.
URL: https://stacklyn.in/services/ai-development

### MVP Development
Stacklyn builds startup MVPs in 8–12 weeks using modern, scalable technologies. Services include product scoping, UI/UX design, full stack development, cloud deployment, and post-launch iteration.
URL: https://stacklyn.in/services/mvp-development

### Custom Software Development
Stacklyn delivers custom software solutions for businesses that need tailored platforms beyond off-the-shelf tools. Services include enterprise software, internal tools, workflow automation, and data platforms.
URL: https://stacklyn.in/services/custom-software-development

## Industries Stacklyn Serves

Stacklyn builds industry-specific enterprise software for industrial companies and MNCs. Each industry practice combines domain workflow knowledge with modern engineering.

### Oil & Gas Software
Digital oilfield platforms, HSE compliance systems, SCADA integration dashboards, crew rotation management, and regulatory reporting for operators and EPC contractors.
URL: https://stacklyn.in/industries/oil-gas-software

### Mining Software
Mine operations platforms, fleet telematics integration (MineStar, Wenco, Modular), HSE compliance, environmental monitoring, and geospatial GIS visualization.
URL: https://stacklyn.in/industries/mining-software

### Construction Software
Project controls platforms, digital daily progress reporting (DPR), BOQ and subcontractor billing, digital measurement books, QA/QC and snagging apps, and material and plant tracking.
URL: https://stacklyn.in/industries/construction-software

### EPC & Engineering Software
Engineering document control, multi-party project portals, vendor expediting platforms, construction field apps, and commissioning management for EPC contractors.
URL: https://stacklyn.in/industries/epc-engineering-software

### Manufacturing Software (MES & Industry 4.0)
Custom manufacturing execution systems, real-time OEE dashboards, PLC/SCADA and IoT connectivity over OPC-UA and Modbus, batch traceability, CMMS, and AI predictive maintenance.
URL: https://stacklyn.in/industries/manufacturing-software

### Logistics & Supply Chain Software
Transport management systems (TMS), warehouse management systems (WMS), live fleet and consignment tracking, driver and POD apps, freight forwarding platforms, and customer visibility portals.

### Marine & Shipping Software
Fleet operations dashboards, crew management and STCW certification tracking, planned maintenance systems (PMS), voyage and bunker analytics, port call coordination, and offline vessel inspection apps.
URL: https://stacklyn.in/industries/marine-shipping-software

### Renewable Energy & Utilities Software
Solar and wind portfolio monitoring, multi-OEM inverter and SCADA integration, yield and loss diagnostics, O&M ticketing with offline field apps, and automated generation and PPA reporting.

### Facility Management Software (CAFM & CMMS)
CAFM and CMMS platforms, QR-tagged asset registers, planned preventive maintenance scheduling, offline technician apps, tenant helpdesk portals, and SLA and penalty dashboards.

### Field Service Management Software (FSM)
Job scheduling and dispatch consoles, offline technician apps, AMC and warranty contract management, spare parts and van stock tracking, customer portals, and service profitability analytics.

### HSE & Compliance Software
Digital permit-to-work (ePTW), incident and near-miss reporting, audit and inspection apps, JSA and HIRA risk assessment tools, competency matrices, and contractor compliance portals.

## Gulf & Global Oil and Gas Markets

Stacklyn builds custom oil and gas and industrial software for operators, EPC contractors, and service companies in the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, and Oman, and for companies in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and Norway that outsource development to India. Software is designed around each market's operator requirements (such as ADNOC and Saudi Aramco contractor HSE practice), localisation programmes (UAE ICV, Saudi IKTVA, Qatar TAWTEEN, Oman ICV), and data protection laws. India is 1.5 hours ahead of the UAE and Oman and 2.5 hours ahead of Saudi Arabia and Qatar.
Hub: https://stacklyn.in/markets

### UAE Oil & Gas Software
Custom oil and gas software for UAE operators, EPC contractors, and ADNOC suppliers — digital permit to work, HSE, ICV reporting, crew rotation, and operations dashboards. Arabic and English. Built by Stacklyn.
URL: https://stacklyn.in/markets/oil-gas-software-uae

### Saudi Arabia Oil & Gas Software
Custom oil and gas software for Saudi Arabia — digital work permits aligned to Aramco GI 2.100 practice, HSE and incident management, IKTVA data, and Arabic-first operations systems for contractors in Dhahran, Jubail, and Yanbu.
URL: https://stacklyn.in/markets/oil-gas-software-saudi-arabia

### Qatar Oil & Gas Software
Custom oil, gas, and LNG software for Qatar — permit to work, HSE management, contractor compliance, TAWTEEN supplier data, and project dashboards for companies in Ras Laffan, Mesaieed, and Doha.
URL: https://stacklyn.in/markets/oil-gas-software-qatar

### Oman Oil & Gas Software
Custom oil and gas software for Oman — HSE management for PDO contractors, permit to work, ICV and Omanisation reporting, JSRS supplier compliance, and field operations apps for Muscat, Sohar, and Duqm.
URL: https://stacklyn.in/markets/oil-gas-software-oman

### ICV Reporting Software (UAE)
Custom ICV reporting software for UAE suppliers and ADNOC contractors — track local spend, supplier ICV certificates, workforce and Emiratisation data, simulate your ICV score, and prepare certification audits.
URL: https://stacklyn.in/markets/icv-reporting-software-uae

### Outsource Oil & Gas Software to India
Outsource oil and gas software development to an India-based engineering team — HSE, permit to work, field apps, SCADA dashboards, and operations platforms for companies in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, Norway, and the Gulf.
URL: https://stacklyn.in/markets/oil-gas-software-outsourcing-india

## AI & Automation (Kerala & India)

Stacklyn is a Kerala-based AI and automation company. AI solutions are grounded in each client's own data, evaluated before launch, and use human approval for financial and compliance actions. Malayalam, Hindi, and English are supported for chat and voice.
Hub: https://stacklyn.in/ai-automation

### AI Chatbot Development
Stacklyn builds custom AI chatbots for Kerala and Indian businesses — website, WhatsApp, and in-app assistants trained on your own data, with Malayalam, Hindi, and English support.
URL: https://stacklyn.in/ai-automation/ai-chatbot-development

### WhatsApp AI Chatbot & Automation
Stacklyn builds WhatsApp AI chatbots and automation on the official WhatsApp Business Platform — lead capture, order updates, payment reminders, and catalogue sales for Kerala and Indian businesses.
URL: https://stacklyn.in/ai-automation/whatsapp-ai-chatbot

### Malayalam AI Chatbot & Voice Bot
Stacklyn builds Malayalam AI chatbots and voice bots for Kerala businesses and service organisations — handling Malayalam script, Manglish, and English in text and speech.
URL: https://stacklyn.in/ai-automation/malayalam-ai-chatbot

### AI Agent Development
Stacklyn builds AI agents that complete multi-step business tasks — researching, updating CRMs, processing documents, and coordinating workflows — with human approval and audit trails. Kerala, India.
URL: https://stacklyn.in/ai-automation/ai-agent-development

### RAG & Private Knowledge Base AI
Stacklyn builds retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems that let teams ask questions of company documents, SOPs, contracts, and databases with cited answers and access controls. Kerala, India.
URL: https://stacklyn.in/ai-automation/rag-knowledge-base-ai

### AI Voice Agents & Call Automation
Stacklyn builds AI voice agents for inbound and outbound calls — appointment booking, lead qualification, payment reminders, and support — in English, Hindi, and Malayalam, integrated with Indian telephony.
URL: https://stacklyn.in/ai-automation/ai-voice-agent

### Business Process Automation
Stacklyn automates repetitive business processes for Kerala and Indian companies — approvals, data entry, reporting, invoicing, and follow-ups — connecting Tally, Zoho, WhatsApp, email, and spreadsheets.
URL: https://stacklyn.in/ai-automation/business-process-automation

### n8n, Make & Zapier Automation
Stacklyn builds, deploys, and maintains n8n, Make, and Zapier automations for Indian businesses — AI workflows, CRM and WhatsApp integrations, and self-hosted n8n in Indian cloud regions.
URL: https://stacklyn.in/ai-automation/n8n-automation-agency

### Tally & GST Automation
Stacklyn automates Tally and GST workflows — invoice data entry, e-invoice and e-way bill generation, GSTR-2B reconciliation, outstanding reminders, and MIS reports — for Kerala and Indian businesses.
URL: https://stacklyn.in/ai-automation/tally-gst-automation

### AI Document Processing & Invoice Automation
Stacklyn builds AI document processing that extracts data from invoices, purchase orders, KYC documents, forms, and contracts — including scanned and handwritten pages — and pushes it into your systems.
URL: https://stacklyn.in/ai-automation/invoice-document-ai

### CRM & Sales Automation
Stacklyn sets up and automates CRMs for Kerala and Indian sales teams — lead capture from IndiaMART, Meta ads, and WhatsApp, instant assignment, follow-up sequences, and AI-assisted sales insights.
URL: https://stacklyn.in/ai-automation/crm-sales-automation

### HR & Recruitment Automation
Stacklyn automates HR and recruitment for Indian companies — AI-assisted resume screening, interview scheduling, onboarding workflows, leave and attendance automation, and employee helpdesk assistants.
URL: https://stacklyn.in/ai-automation/hr-recruitment-automation

## Technology Stack

**Frontend:** React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Flutter
**Backend:** Node.js, Express.js, Fastify, NestJS
**Database:** PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Supabase
**Cloud:** AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Vercel, Cloudflare
**AI/ML:** OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Pinecone, Weaviate
**DevOps:** Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines
